verdict.rationale: Convex functions (queries/mutations/actions) are exposed via public HTTP endpoints and a CLI, and an MCP server lets AI agents run functions, import data, and inspect deployments programmatically, covering most core dev workflows without the dashboard UI. However, there's no documented OpenAPI spec (probe found 404s) and no evidence that dashboard-only features (e.g., insights, logs, some admin/config actions) are fully exposed via HTTP/API rather than CLI/MCP alone. Missing for 10: OpenAPI/machine-readable API spec, explicit confirmation that all UI-only admin/dashboard actions have API/CLI parity, and independent hands-on verification beyond docs.
